svg.aria-label: Six steps: strip 2 cm from both wire ends, wrap 10 tight turns round the nail in the same direction, tape the coil, push end A into one battery terminal, touch end B to the other terminal for up to 5 seconds and pick up paper clips, let go and count.
svg.title: Six steps: strip 2 cm from both wire ends, wrap 10 tight turns round the nail in the same direction, tape the coil, push end A into one battery terminal, touch end B to the other terminal for up to 5 seconds and pick up paper clips, let go and count.
svg.text: 10 tight turns, all the SAME way.
Tape both ends of the coil
Push end A into one terminal.
Touch end B on the other one.
Count them. Then add more turns.
